# Streak CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Mailbox-driven sales | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether mailbox-driven sales actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Light Recruitment | The main link, “lists or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether light recruitment actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Financing and investment relations | Using “list or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the flash drive, to verify whether the financing-investment relationship really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Client support or project pipeline | The main link, “list or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double disk”, is used to verify whether customer support or project pipelines actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
